{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront39.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{3: 'The sea is black as ink, streaked with white foam from the breaking waves. A storm is coming, and an uneasy air hangs over the waters.'}
{3: 'From the deck, you can just make out the enemy ship in the distance. Against the roaring chaos of sea and sky, its crimson banner cuts through the gloom like a fresh wound.'}

{1: '1', 3: 'Even more striking is the silver-white hair whipping in the wind before the bridge. Its owner stands at the very front of the enemy vessel like a steady anchor, utterly unmoved by the storm around her.'}
{3: "Her eyes meet yours across the water. You can't see her clearly at this distance, but you understand exactly what she's waiting for."}
{3: "She's waiting for the moment—a moment that has been a long time coming."}
{3: 'So are you.'}
{3: 'The rigging shrieks as the waves rise higher and higher. You make a quick call.'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront39.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.5'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1582.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1582.jpg'}
{2: "What's the wind doing?", 3: '19'}
{3: 'One of the soldiers steps out from the formation. His booming report carries cleanly over the howling wind.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Maximum gusts are up to fifty-two knots! Force Nine gale!', 4: '1', 18: '100020315'}
{3: "Force Nine on the Beaufort scale. That's the signal. The final battle is about to begin."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{3: 'Twelve hours earlier, deep in the night.'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1492.jpg'}
{1: 'Collaborative Teaching Center', 2: 'F.O.S. Military Command College'}
{2: 'F.O.S. Military Command College, Collaborative Teaching Center'}

{3: "It's well past midnight. Most of the students and instructors have already turned in, and every light in the building has been switched off. Only the low hum of machinery still drifts from the tactical simulation chamber, where a holographic map of the strait bathes the room in a pale glow."}
{3: "A naval battle. That's the scenario waiting inside the simulation. A few taps on the screen bring up the rest of the briefing."}
{3: 'Forewarned is forearmed. Before students enter a simulated battle, the system normally gives them enough information to prepare.'}
{3: 'The more detailed the information, the more complicated the scenario tends to be. One quick look at the unpredictable weather forecast is enough to make you frown.'}
{3: 'Every detail points to the same conclusion—this assessment is going to be brutal.'}
{2: 'So this is what I get for asking for a supplemental assessment...', 3: '41'}
{3: 'You let out a sigh, and your thoughts return to the public simulation exam from a few days earlier.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory318.png'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMovieFilm.prefab', 2: '3'}

{1: "Near the end of the battle, the system forced you into an impossible choice: Your flank came under sudden attack just as the enemy began advancing along the main front, and you didn't have enough troops to hold both.", 5: '1'}
{1: 'Advanced exercises are built around dilemmas like this. They force students to set emotion aside and decide what must be sacrificed.'}
{1: 'The accepted answer—or at least the one chosen by most high-scoring students—was to abandon the flank and sacrifice the troops there in exchange for control of the wider battle.'}

{1: 'Under the simulation rules, losing the main defensive line meant losing the entire operation. Rather than risk both fronts collapsing, the logical choice was to concentrate every available unit on the center and sacrifice the flank to preserve the overall position.'}

{1: "You chose differently. You divided your forces, sending enough troops to stabilize the flank and cover an orderly retreat, then used everyone who remained to slow the enemy's advance along the main front."}
{1: 'Buying time for the evacuation stretched your defenses thinner with every passing minute. A battle that could have ended quickly became a long and punishing war of attrition.', 7: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1492.jpg'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{3: 'One by one, the other students finished their simulations and left their pods, but your battle kept going. By the time it finally ended, you were the last student still connected.'}
{1: 'Evaluation in progress. Battle duration recorded. Calculating equipment losses...', 3: '50', 4: 'ffffff'}
{1: 'System', 2: 'Evaluation in progress. Battle duration recorded. Calculating equipment losses...'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Student A', 3: '【kuroname】, what took you so long this time?', 4: '1', 18: '100020317'}
{2: 'I was trying to get as many soldiers out alive as possible.', 3: '67', 4: "Things didn't go according to plan.", 5: '68'}

{2: 'Student A', 3: "Oof... But dragging the battle out that long must've wrecked your other numbers. Even the high survival rate probably won't be enough to make up for it. Your score's going to be rough...", 4: '1', 18: '100020318'}

{2: 'Student A', 3: "You mean the surprise attack on the flank? Yeah, I abandoned that whole sector. If I'd tried to save it, the battle would've dragged on forever and destroyed my score.", 4: '1', 18: '100020319'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMovieFilm.prefab'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Your classmate was right. When the results came in, you received the lowest score of your academic career.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'The automatic report acknowledged your unusually high troop survival rate, but it barely affected the final result. The main reason appeared in bold: Insufficient tactical efficiency.'}
{1: "The system's definition of efficiency was simple: Achieve the greatest possible result in the shortest time while expending the fewest resources."}

{1: 'But how did the algorithm account for human lives? To the system, the additional losses caused by covering the evacuation were unnecessary costs. To you, refusing to abandon those soldiers was a line that could not be crossed.'}

{1: 'The soldiers in the simulation might not have been real, but the choices were. Every tactical decision—and every life a commandant chose to save or sacrifice—helped shape the values they carried into the real world.'}
{1: 'If someone lowered their standards simply because it was only a simulation, then one day they might start treating real lives the same way—as nothing more than numbers on a screen.'}
{1: 'That was why you treated every simulation like a real battle. Abandoning lives in the name of efficiency was not true efficiency at all.'}
{1: "To you, keeping soldiers alive should have carried more weight than any other metric. You couldn't accept the result without question, so you immediately requested a review.", 7: '1'}
{3: 'Once classes ended that day, you requested access to the tactical simulation chamber and returned to check the outcome.'}
{1: 'Review complete. Your final score is as follows...', 3: '50', 4: 'ffffff'}
{1: 'System', 2: 'Review complete. Your final score is as follows...', 3: '100020320'}
{3: 'The score remained unchanged. But just as you closed the last feedback window, a new prompt appeared.'}
{1: 'Student 【kuroname】 has met the requirements for a supplemental assessment. Would you like to proceed?', 3: '50', 4: 'ffffff'}
{1: 'System', 2: 'Student 【kuroname】 has met the requirements for a supplemental assessment. Would you like to proceed?', 3: '100020321'}
{1: 'You read through the conditions and accepted without hesitation. A special authorization code was immediately sent to your terminal.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'And that is why you are sitting in the tactical simulation chamber now.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'You continue through the briefing. According to the appendix, the scenario is based on a real naval battle—one fought long before the Golden Age.'}
{1: 'This will be a pure test of command, with almost none of the advanced technology you normally rely on.'}
{1: 'That makes it all the more important to review the pre-battle briefing in advance. After all, thorough preparation is the key to improving your chances in any situation.', 6: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg'}
{1: 'Currents, tide tables, reef formations—every piece of data is laid out before you.', 5: '1'}

{1: "It's a narrow, reef-filled strait that is frequently covered in dense fog. Dangerous as it is, it contains the only safe shipping route between two great oceans, giving it enormous strategic value. For centuries, that importance has drawn pirates and fleets into its waters."}
{1: 'Perhaps because the simulation follows a real historical event so closely, the briefing is unusually detailed, even covering the origins of both factions.'}
{1: 'The two sides once belonged to the same maritime alliance, but a deep ideological divide split it into rival factions decades ago.'}

{1: 'The supplementary material also describes the culture of the old coastal power in detail. Its age of glory is long gone, and the military codes and flag signals once carried across its vast fleets have faded into relics of another era.'}
{1: "The conservative faction—the side you will command—kept the gray from the old alliance's banner, while the former war hawks claimed its bold crimson."}

{1: 'They share the same waters, speak with the same accent, and inherit the same culture. Once, they sailed beneath one flag. Now gray and red banners face each other across the sea, with cannons aimed at people who were once comrades.', 7: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1492.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1492.jpg'}
{2: "In a sense, it's a civil war.", 3: '114'}
{3: 'The two factions have been locked in a standoff over the strait for years, while hardliners on both sides wait for an excuse to settle it by force.'}

{3: 'Their different political paths have also shaped their militaries. The gray faction is known to be weaker, but the exact difference in strength will not be revealed until the simulation begins.'}
{3: 'To prevent cheating, the system withholds all operational intelligence until the assessment starts. Most participants would ignore historical material like this.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStorySlowlyCloseEye.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStorySlowlyCloseEye.prefab'}
{3: 'Once you have reviewed everything, you settle into the simulation pod and let your awareness sink into a vast current of data.'}
{3: 'A clear system chime sounds inside your mind.'}
{1: 'Identity confirmed: 【kuroname】. Constructing simulated battlefield.', 3: '50', 4: 'ffffff'}
{1: 'System', 2: '"Identity confirmed: 【kuroname】. Constructing simulated battlefield."', 3: '100020322'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory17.jpg'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{3: 'Elsewhere...'}
{3: 'Adelyde is on her way back to the lounge.'}
{3: 'She has just finished a full day of demanding assignments, yet not a trace of exhaustion shows in her stride.'}
{3: 'Her terminal suddenly chimes.'}
{3: "She opens the notification, expecting another duty update or emergency assignment. It's neither. The title alone brings her to a stop."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: '"Accept tactical simulation match"...?', 4: '1', 18: '100020323'}
{3: 'Adelyde narrows her eyes.'}
{3: 'The notification comes from the instructor side of the tactical simulation system. A student has triggered a supplementary assessment request.'}
{3: 'The requirements for this advanced matching system are extremely strict. It only becomes available when an outstanding and well-trained student requests a review of their score.'}
{3: 'The reason provided for the request is: "I question the result and request a new assessment."'}
{3: 'She can barely remember the last time she received a notification like this.'}
{3: 'F.O.S. has never lacked bright students, or students whose confidence borders on arrogance. But a student who requests a supplementary assessment because they question the result—'}
{3: 'As someone who turned her back on the Helio family, she knows this type all too well. Young people who push past the rules just to prove themselves are often one step away from disaster.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: "There's a fine line between courage and recklessness.", 4: '1', 18: '100020324'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Which side are you on?', 4: '1', 18: '100020325'}
{3: 'From what she knows of the tactical simulation system, this battle is unusually difficult even by its standards. The projected chance of victory is below 0.42%.'}

{3: 'One of the hidden conditions makes the assessment inherently unfair: Instead of facing a simulated opponent, the student will be matched against an active F.O.S. instructor whose identity is concealed.'}
{3: 'Most students back out as soon as they enter the simulation and see the gap in forces.'}
{3: 'By now, the student who submitted the request should already be inside, waiting.'}
{3: "But Adelyde hasn't received a cancellation notice."}
{3: 'She finds herself growing curious about this unknown student. At the very least, they have the courage to accept the challenge.'}
{3: 'Or perhaps their stubbornness reminds her, just faintly, of her younger self.'}
{3: 'She accepts the match.'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiKeJiChuXian.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg'}
{3: 'The simulated battlefield finishes loading.'}
{3: 'A narrow strait stretches before you, crowded with reefs and churned by hidden currents.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryZhengyanNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1595.jpg'}
{3: "When you open your eyes again, you're standing somewhere else entirely."}
{3: "Judging by the layout and the personnel gathered inside, this must be the ship's operations room."}

{3: "It feels nothing like Babylonia or any command center you're familiar with. The salt in the air, the deck rolling beneath your feet, the waves pounding against the hull—every sensation tells you you're at sea."}
{3: 'You glance down at your uniform and hands. The system has given you its standard anonymous avatar, with no recognizable features or identifying marks.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The first officer steps forward and salutes.'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "Commandant, we've completed our initial reconnaissance!", 4: '1', 18: '100020327'}
{3: "The middle-aged officer's booming voice fills the room."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/IconMovie/V480haituNormal01.png'}

{3: 'The first officer spreads a nautical chart across the table. The strait unfolds before you, its narrow waterways split into a web of passages by dense reefs on either side, every channel crowded with hazard markings.'}
{3: 'He gives you a quick, concise overview of the surrounding waters. It matches the pre-battle briefing almost exactly.'}
{3: 'With the geography confirmed, you turn to the next critical question.'}
{2: 'What are we up against?', 3: '198'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "Red has more capital ships than we do. Our small-vessel numbers are roughly even, but overall, we're outmatched by about thirty percent.", 4: '18', 18: '100020329'}
{3: "He marks both fleets' approximate positions on the chart. Red's formation is packed tightly on the open-water side, with its capital ships standing out immediately."}

{3: "Gray's fleet sits on the far side of the reef belt. It has far fewer capital ships, while its destroyers are scattered in small groups. Compared with Red's imposing formation, the imbalance is obvious."}
{3: 'Only one main channel runs through the reefs.'}
{2: "What are our ships' drafts?", 3: '206'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Our capital ships draw an average of six meters. The destroyers draw between two and three.', 4: '1', 18: '100020330'}
{2: 'And the water depth inside the reef belt?', 3: '209'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'The shallowest waters are about four meters deep. Only small vessels can pass through safely.', 4: '1', 18: '100020331'}
{3: 'You quickly process the information.'}
{3: "If the battle stays in open water, your side won't have a single meaningful advantage."}
{3: 'Inside the reef belt, however, the situation changes.'}
{3: "Red's capital ships draw too much water to move through the reefs. They'll be forced to use the only main channel."}
{3: 'If you can draw the battle into the reef belt, your larger fleet of smaller vessels will have the advantage, turning your weakness into an opportunity.'}
{3: 'The real problem is getting Red to fight there.'}
{3: "That means you'll have to move first."}
{2: "What's the current visibility?", 3: '221'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "Dense fog has covered the strait. Visibility is under two cables and should keep dropping for the next hour. My best estimate is that it won't begin improving until about an hour before high tide.", 4: '1', 18: '100020332'}
{2: 'Your best estimate? How reliable is it?', 3: '224'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'No one in this fleet knows these waters better than I do.', 4: '1', 18: '100020333'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "If I can't predict it, no one can.", 4: '1', 18: '100020334'}
{3: 'Two cables—just over three hundred meters. At that visibility, even skilled gunners will see their shots go far off target.'}
{3: "If your small vessels can use the fog to secure the reef belt's key positions first, the advantage will be immediate."}
{3: "If Red attacks now, they'll be forced to fire into the fog with little idea what they're aiming at. If the engagement drags on, they'll burn through ammunition at an unsustainable rate."}
{3: 'Everything depends on how long the fog holds.'}
{2: 'How long until high tide?', 3: '233'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'According to the tide tables, roughly four hours.', 4: '1', 18: '100020335'}
{3: "You trace the reef belt again and mark several chokepoints where destroyers can maneuver freely but capital ships can't follow."}
{3: 'The outline of a plan begins to take shape.'}
{3: "Send the destroyers into the reefs and use the low visibility to create a feint. If Red believes an attack is coming from the flank, they'll have to split their formation."}
{3: 'Once they do, their formation will lose its strength. You can seize the initiative and take them on one group at a time.'}
{2: 'Split the destroyers into two groups—no, three. Send all three into the reef belt.', 3: '241'}
{2: 'Maintain radio silence and shut down every signal light.', 3: '242'}
{2: 'The main fleet will hold its current position and await further orders.', 3: '243'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Understood!', 4: '1', 18: '100020336'}
{3: "The orders are relayed, and the first officer leaves with the rest of the crew to carry them out. Soon, you're alone in the operations room."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiFogNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg'}
{3: 'You walk to the porthole and look into the fog. Countless dangers lie hidden in that wall of gray, and somewhere beyond them waits your opponent.'}
{3: 'A faint smear of red shows through the mist, carrying the unmistakable promise of battle.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiFogNew.prefab'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1595.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1595.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/IconMovie/V480mingceNormal01.png'}
{3: 'As you turn back, you notice a crew roster partly hidden beneath the chart on the conference table.'}
{3: 'You pull it free and place it where you can see it clearly.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1593.jpg'}
{3: "At the same time, on Red's bridge..."}
{3: 'By the time Adelyde enters the simulated battlefield, the charts have already been spread across the table.'}
{3: 'Her first officer approaches immediately, reporting that Gray appears to be moving. Their scouts have picked up the low hum of advancing ships.'}
{3: "But Gray remains hidden among the reefs and fog. Their exact movements are unclear, and the only thing that can be confirmed is that the flagship hasn't moved."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'The flagship is stationary, but something else is moving?', 4: '1', 18: '100020337'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "Don't advance yet. Hold our current positions.", 4: '1', 18: '100020338'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/IconMovie/V480haituNormal01.png'}
{3: "She gives the order and studies the chart. Red's battleship markers sit heavily across the open-water side like an iron gate, while Gray's smaller icons look almost weightless by comparison."}
{3: 'The briefing continues: the reef belt, the width of the main channel, the positions of both fleets...'}
{3: "Red's capital ships can only use the main channel. Her opponent will have reached the same conclusion."}
{3: "If Adelyde were commanding the weaker fleet, she'd pull the battle into the reefs. It's the only way to use the terrain to reverse the balance of power."}
{3: 'Her gaze moves from the main channel to several critical chokepoints within the reef belt.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Report current visibility.', 4: '1', 18: '100020339'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Red First Officer', 3: 'Under two cables. The fog is expected to last for several hours.', 4: '1', 18: '100020340'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'How badly does the fog affect our firing accuracy?', 4: '1', 18: '100020341'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Red First Officer', 3: 'S-Significantly... At medium range, our hit rate drops below forty percent of normal.', 4: '1', 18: '100020342'}
{3: 'Not an encouraging number. A hit rate below forty percent means far more wasted ammunition.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiFogNew.prefab', 2: '2'}

{3: "She takes the binoculars from the table and walks to the bridge's forward observation window, raising them toward the fog."}
{3: "Through the haze, she can barely make out the reef belt. The tip of Gray's flagship mast appears and disappears in the mist."}
